SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
(印：SHANGHAI File No. ... S. R. D. 8968)
S.1, Special Branch 4/1/39
REPORT
Date January 19, 1939.

Subject U.S. Surgeon Lieut. Powell, Room 813, Park Hotel - Molestation
by means of menacing telephone calls, etc.
Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by C. Crawford J.J

At 11 a.m. January 19, 1939, Capt. L. Crommiller, Jr.,
Law Officer, U.S. Fourth Marines, called at the Special
Branch and made the following complaint :-

Recently a Russian Jewess, namely, Dora Esthir
Gurevich, age about 24, brought a civil action in the local
U.S. Court against U.S. Surgeon Lieut. Powell, Room 813, Park
Hotel, charging him with having raped her in Hankow in
March, 1938 as a result of which she became pregnant. The
charge was dismissed by the U.S. Court on January 11, 1939.
Since the latter date Surgeon Lieut. Powell has been
molested by means of numerous telephone calls received at
his room in the Park Hotel from unknown persons, both male
and female, who without making direct threats of physical
violence against him, succeeded in injecting a certain
menacing tone into their communications. These communications
never come to the point but usually take the form of :-
"I want to see you on the Bund immediately, it is important
that you come right away" etc.

Requests by Surgeon Lieut. Powell that the speaker
should come to see him in his room or state his or her
identity always resulted in the individual concerned hanging
up the phone.

Capt. Crommiller stated that he did not wish any
Court case to ensue as Surgeon Lieut. Powell had suffered
enough embarrassment already but wished to know if steps
could be taken to put a stop to the systemised molestation.

Miss Gurevich, namely, Mrs. Adel Borisovna Murphy, wife of

报告
日期：1939年1月19日。

事由：美国海军外科中尉鲍威尔（Powell），住国际饭店813室——遭受恐吓电话等形式的骚扰
呈报人：侦探副督察洛根（Logan） 转呈人：C. Crawford J.J

1939年1月19日上午11时，美国海军陆战队第四团法务官 L. Crommiller 上尉莅临特务科，提出如下投诉：

近期，一名俄籍犹太女子，即多拉·埃斯希尔·古列维奇（Dora Esthir Gurevich），约24岁，向当地美国法院对美国海军外科中尉鲍威尔（住国际饭店813室）提起民事诉讼，指控其于1938年3月在汉口强奸她，致其怀孕。该指控已于1939年1月11日被美国法院驳回。自该日起，鲍威尔中尉在其国际饭店房间内接到大量来自不明身份男女的电话骚扰，这些人虽未直接对他发出人身暴力威胁，但在通话中成功注入了一种恐吓语气。这些通话从未切入正题，通常采取如下形式：“我要立刻在外滩见你，你必须马上来”等等。

当鲍威尔中尉要求通话者来其房间见面或表明身份时，对方总是挂断电话。

克罗米勒（Crommiller）上尉表示，鉴于鲍威尔中尉已遭受足够多的尴尬，他不希望引发任何诉讼案件，但希望知悉能否采取措施制止这种有系统的骚扰行为。

有充分理由相信，古列维奇小姐的姐姐，即阿德尔·鲍里索夫娜·墨菲（Adel Borisovna Murphy）太太（浦东美孚石油公司一名官员之妻），及其刚从华德路监狱获释的弟弟，即马克·鲍里索维奇·古列维奇（Mark Borisovich Gurevich），是实施骚扰的责任人。鉴于古列维奇家族在当地声誉不佳，鲍威尔中尉非常担心遭受人身暴力。

由于难以有效核查像国际饭店这样的地方的电话来电，有人建议鲍威尔中尉应安排将所有打往国际饭店的电话转接至电话号码78005（克罗米勒上尉的私人电话），并与电话公司安排核查所有拨打该号码的来电，从而追踪骚扰鲍威尔中尉者的身份，此后便有可能警告相关人员停止此类行为。

W. 洛根
侦探副督察

呈警务处副处长（特务科） 副处长（特务科）
1月19日。

an official of the Standard Oil Co., Pootung, and her brother
who was recently released from Ward Road Gaol, namely,
Mark Borisovich Gurevich, are the persons responsible for
the molestation. Surgeon Lieut. Powell is in considerable
fear of physical violence as the Gurevich family has
rather a shady reputation locally.

Owing to the difficulty of effectively checking
telephone calls to a place like the Park Hotel it was
suggested that Lieut. Powell should make arrangements to
have all telephone calls to the Park Hotel referred to
Tel. No.78005 (Capt. Crommiller's private telephone) and
that arrangements should be made with the Telephone Co.
to check all calls to the latter number and thereby trace
the identity of the persons annoying Lieut. Powell, after
which it should be possible to warn the persons concerned to
desist.

W. Logan
D. S. I.

Subject (in full) U.S. Surgeon Lieut. Powell, Room 813, Park Hotel -
molestation by means of menacing telephone calls, etc.

Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.I.

With reference to Special Branch report on the
above subject dated 19.1.39, and D.C. (Special Branch)'s
memo. dated 20.1.39 attached thereto, Capt. L. Cronmiller
Jr., Law officer, Fourth U.S. Marines, was informed
along the lines indicated in D.C. (Special Branch)'s
memo. aforesaid, and in reply stated that he would advise
Lieut. Powell accordingly.

Logan
D. S. I.
